title: Inconsistent Results
text:
Inconsistent Results. I have had trouble with sleep for years and I have tried numerous things to get better sleep, with limited success. Though this device isn’t a sleep aid, it is a sleep monitor (of sorts) and I looked to it in the hopes of finding some clues about my rest patterns at night. I came away disappointed, though it does have some useful/interesting features.

This seems like a very unconventional device for a sleep study. It’s basically a pad with sensors talking to software on a portable device, via Bluetooth. I am not thrilled with the idea of using my phone to monitor me all night long, though I am less concerned about using this with a tablet.

Like others, I had some real trouble getting this thing to read correctly and it gave me very inconsistent results. Following the advice given by other reviewers, I was not able to get it to read completely reliably, though positioning farther towards the center of the bed made it read a little more consistently. It was worth trying. I’m still trying to get it to play ball a little more reliably.

The software seems to be well thought out and is fairly intuitive.

As it stands, this device seems to be a good idea with some room for improvement. Based on my experiences I am having a difficult time recommending it because I cannot get it to work as it should. If I am successful in getting it to read and report properly, I will revisit.
